An Inventory of Goods and  Chattels Rights and Credits of Esther Fransisco free woman of colour late of Little Creek Hundred Kent County in the state of Delaware deceased as shown to us by Jacob Stout her administrator and appraised the 3 day of 12th month
To a bedstead bed and beding
To suit of Curtens table cloth and 3 towels
To 2 old Chests and 1 trunk 1 old Looking Glass
To a Lot of books/hooks(?) 3 spoons and a small bunch of cotton
To 1 old walnut table and a small pine one
To 1 Lage arm Chair and 2 of smaller ones & frying pan

Personally appeared Jonathan Alston and John Cowgill before me the subscriber one of the Justices of the Peace in and for said County and upon solemn affirmations declared that the above and foregoing Inventory of appraisement or valuation of the effects of Esther Fransisco is a Conscionable(?) one.
To James Harper Register, Jacob Stout Admn. of Esther Francisco dec'd renders the following acct. of his administration of said deceaseds Estate & craves its adjustments.
To Cash od Wm. Knotts as per Probt.
To ditto Rachel Harpers amt. Nursing intestate in  death sickness per Probt.
To ditto pd. ditto part of funeral expenses per Probt.
To ditto pd. James Sykes per Probt.
To ditto pd. Sykes & Naudain per ditto
To ditto pd. Thos. Stevenson Judge (unclear)
To fees for passing this account
By Cash amt. from Rachel Harpers money  in Intestates possession at her death
Examined adjusted passed and Settled this 13th day of August,
